title: August and the Portrait
author: Marguerite Kavanagh
blurb: Odile Vasquez, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
